task.question: Where was the 2026 Major League Baseball All-Star Game held?
task.evidence: July 14: 2026 Major League Baseball All-Star Game at Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

answer:
The 2026 Major League Baseball All-Star Game was held at Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The site was chosen to commemorate the signing of the Declaration of Independence in Philadelphia on July 4, 1776.

FINAL: Citizens Bank Park, Philadelphia
